correctness.rationale: Reconstructed generator Dirichlet equations on all 14 transient subsets for birth-death updating, resident fecundity fixed to 1, mutant fecundity site-specific r,s; symmetric orbit reduction gives rational expressions for alternating and clustered fixation. Independently solved the uncompressed rational 14-state systems for parameters (1,1),(2,1),(10,1),(4,2),(11,4),(7,3) and verified the stated closed difference. Its denominator is strictly positive for r,s>0 and r!=s; the symmetric numerator polynomial becomes F_ell(h). Descartes sign changes (+,possibly,-,-) give exactly one positive root; diagonal F_ell(ell)=2ell(ell+1)(ell³-2ell²-3ell-3) locates the switch uniquely for ell below ell_c. Equality on diagonal r=s. Finite rational examples do not establish unique-root conclusion without the analytic sign argument.
